entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of those who arrange themselves in proper rows.
And then by those who drive by scolding.
And by those groups who read the Qur'aan.
Indeed, your God is definitely One.
The Owner of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Owners of the Easts (i.e. every point of the sun's rising).
We have indeed adorned the lowest sky with the decoration of stars.
And in order to protect it from every rebellious devil.
They (the devils) cannot listen to the exalted realm (of the angels), and they are pelted from every side.
To chase them away, and for them is a never-ending punishment.
Except the one who sometimes snatches a part (of the speech of the angels); so, a shining flame (i.e. a shooting star) goes after him.

Therefore (O Beloved), ask them, 'Is their creation harder or Our other creation like the heavens, and the angels, etc.?' Indeed, We have created them from sticky clay. (Then how would it be difficult to recreate them?)
Rather, you are surprised (due to them denying resurrection), and they are mocking (you).
And when they are advised, they do not understand (the advice).
And when they see any sign, they mock (it).
And they say, 'This is nothing but clear magic.'
'When we are dead and have turned into dust and bones, will we definitely be raised again?'
'And also our former forefathers?'
Say you (O Beloved), 'Yes, while you will be disgraced.'
So, that (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet) is just a single shout, thereupon they will begin to see.
And they will say, 'Woe upon us!' It will be said to them, 'This is the Day of justice.'
'This is the Day of Judgment, which you used to deny.'
'All the unjust people and their associates, and whatever they used to worship.'
'Instead of Allah. Drive all of them to the path of Hell.'
'And stop them; they are to be questioned.'
'What has happened to you, why you do not help one another?'
Rather, this Day they have all surrendered.
And one of them faced the other questioning each other.
They said, 'It is you who used to come to us from our right side, in order to mislead.'
They will respond, 'You did not have faith yourselves.'
'And we did not have any control over you; rather, you were rebellious people yourselves.'
So, the Word of our Lord has proven true against us, we will surely have to taste (the punishment).'
'We therefore led you astray, because we ourselves were astray.'
So, on that Day, they are all partners in punishment.
This is how We deal with the culprits.
Indeed, whenever it was said to them; that 'There is no one worthy of worship except Allah,' so, they would become arrogant.
And they would say, 'Shall we abandon our gods upon the sayings of a mad poet?'
(He is not a mad poet) rather, he has brought the truth, and he has attested the (previous) Messengers.
'Indeed, you definitely have to taste the painful punishment.'
'And you will not be compensated except for your doings.'
Except the chosen bondsmen of Allah.
For them is such sustenance, which is in Our knowledge.
Fruits; and they will be honoured.
In Gardens of peace.
They will be on the thrones, face to face.
There will be rounds of cups of (pure) flowing wine for them, in front of the eyes.
White in colour, delicious for the drinkers.
Wherein there is no intoxication nor spinning of their head with it (i.e. no hangover).
And with them are those (maidens) who will not set their gaze anywhere else other than towards their husbands, with large (gorgeous) eyes.
As if they were eggs, safely hidden.
So, one amongst them (i.e. the dwellers of Paradise) turns to the other, while questioning.
The speaker among them said, 'I had a companion.'
'Who used to tell me, “Do you believe it is true (i.e. resurrection?”'
'“When we are dead and have turned into dust and bones, so will we be rewarded or punished?”'
He said, 'Will you peep and take a glimpse (into Hell)?'
He therefore looked down and saw him in the middle of the Blazing Fire.
He said, 'By the oath of Allah, you had nearly ruined me.'
'And if my Lord does not bestow (His) Benevolence, I too would have therefore definitely been seized and brought forth (as a prisoner).'
‘So, are we never to die.'
'Except our first death, and we will not be punished?'
'This is certainly the supreme success.'
For this kind of success, doers should work.
So, is this hospitality better, or the tree of Zaqqoom (i.e. a horrible bitter tree in Hell)?
We have indeed made that (tree) a test for the unjust.
Indeed, that is a tree which springs out from the root of Hell.
The shoots of its fruits are like the heads of devils.
Then indeed, they will eat from it, then fill their bellies with it.
Then indeed, on top of it, for them is the mixer of boiling water.
Then indeed, their return is towards the Blazing Fire.
They had indeed found their forefathers astray.
So, they hasten to follow in their footsteps.
And indeed before them, many of the former ones went astray.
And indeed, We had sent warners among them.
Therefore, see what was the outcome of those who were warned.
Except the chosen bondsmen of Allah.
And indeed, Nooh called upon Us, so what an excellent Answerer (of supplication) We are.
And We rescued him and his family from the great calamity.
And We made his children the only survivors.
And We kept his praise amongst the latter generations.
Peace be upon Nooh, amongst the creations in the world.
Undoubtedly, this is how We reward the righteous.
He (Nooh) is indeed one of Our high ranking, entirely-believing bondsmen.
We then drowned the others.
And indeed, Ibrahim is from his group.
When he presented himself before his Lord, with a heart free from other than Allah.
When he (Ibrahim) said to his father and his people, 'What do you worship?'
'Do you desire a god other than Allah through fabrication?'
'So, what is your perception regarding the Lord of all the worlds?'
He then cast a glance at the stars.
He then said, 'I am going to get ill.'
So, they turned their backs on him and went away (because they thought he would transmit the disease).
He then walked towards their idols secretly, so he said, 'Do you not eat?'
'What happened to you that you do not speak?'
So, he began striking them with his right hand, unnoticed by the people.
So, the disbelievers came towards him in haste.
He said, 'Do you worship that which you yourselves have carved with your own hands?'
'Whereas, Allah has created you and your actions.'
They said, 'Construct a building (i.e. a furnace) for him, and then cast him in the Blazing Fire.'
So, they tried to execute their evil scheme upon him, We humiliated them.
And he said, ‘Indeed, I am going to go to my Lord, He will now guide me.'
'O My Lord, bestow upon me righteous offspring.'
We henceforth gave him the glad tidings of an intelligent boy.

And when he became capable of working with him, (Ibrahim) said, 'O my son! I dreamt that I am sacrificing you, now see what is your opinion?' (The son) said, 'O my father! Do what you are being commanded; Allah willing, it is soon that you will find me patient.'
So, when they both submitted to Our command, and the father laid down his son by his forehead; do not ask about that (astonishing) situation.
And We called out to him; that 'O Ibrahim.'
'You have indeed made the dream come true.' And this is how We reward the virtuous.
Indeed, this was a clear test.
And We rescued him (Isma'eel) in exchange for a great sacrifice.
And We kept his praise amongst the latter generations.
Peace be upon Ibrahim.
This is how We reward the virtuous.
He is indeed one of Our high ranking, entirely-believing bondsmen.
And We gave him the glad tidings of Is-haaq, that (he will be a) conveyor of the unseen news, a Prophet, from amongst those who deserve Our proximity.
And We sent blessings upon him and Is-haaq; and amongst their children, one who does good deeds, and one clearly wrongs himself.
And We indeed did a great favour upon Moosa and Haaroon.
And rescued them and their nation from the great distress.
And We helped them, so they became victorious.
And We bestowed the Luminous Book (i.e. the Tawrah) to both of them.
And showed them the Straight Path.
And We kept their praise amongst the latter generations.
Peace be upon Moosa and Haaroon.
This is how We reward the virtuous.
Indeed, they both are amongst Our high ranking, entirely-believing bondsmen.
And indeed, Ilyaas is of the Messengers.
When he said to his nation, 'Do you not fear?'
'Do you worship Ba'l (an idol) and leave the Best Creator?'
'Allah, Who is your Lord and the Lord of your former forefathers.'
Thereafter they belied him, so they will definitely be seized.
Except the chosen bondsmen of Allah.
And We kept his praise amongst the latter generations.
Peace be upon Ilyaas.
This is how We reward the virtuous.
He is indeed one of Our high ranking, entirely-believing bondsmen.
And indeed, Loot is of the Messengers.
When We rescued him and his entire family.
Except an old woman, who became amongst those who stayed behind.
We then destroyed the others.
And indeed, you (O disbelievers of Makkah) pass over them (i.e. over their deserted houses) in the morning (when you travel).
And during the night (also pass therefrom), so do you not have sense?
And indeed, Yunus is of the Messengers.
When he left towards the loaded ship.
So, he drew lots (as to who should be thrown into the sea), he therefore became amongst those who were pushed (into the sea).
The fish then swallowed him and he was blaming himself.
And had he not been of those who glorify (Allah).
He would have definitely remained in its belly till the day when the people will be raised.
Then We cast him on the shore (out of the whale's belly) and he was ill.
And We grew a tree of gourd (as a miraculous shelter) above him.
And We sent him towards a hundred thousand people, rather more.
So they believed, We henceforth gave them benefit (i.e. enjoyment of life) for a while.
Therefore ask them (O Beloved), whether the daughters are for your Lord and the sons for them?
Or that have We created the angels as females, and were they present (at the time of their creation)?
Pay heed! Indeed, they say (this) out of their fabrication.
That 'Allah has offspring.' And indeed, they are definitely liars.
Has He chosen daughters instead of sons?
What is the matter with you? What sort of judgement do you give?
So, do you not ponder (that Allah is free from wives and children)?
Or do you have some clear proof?
Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
And they have appointed kinship between Him and the Jinn; and indeed, the Jinn most definitely know that they (who made such claims) will definitely be brought (to be put into Hell).
Purity is to Allah from the matters they relate.
Except the chosen bondsmen of Allah.
Therefore, you and all what you worship other than Allah.
(All of) you cannot mislead anyone against Him.
Except the one who is going into the Blazing Fire.
And the angels say, 'Each one of us has a known station.'
'And indeed, we, with our wings spread, await the command.'
'And indeed, we are those who glorify Him.'
And indeed they (i.e. the disbelievers) used to say (before the arrival of the Beloved Prophet Muhammad).
'If we had some advice (i.e. a Book) like that of the earlier generations.'
'Then (by practicing it), we would surely have been the chosen bondsmen of Allah.'
So they denied it (i.e. the Qur'aan), therefore they will soon come to know (of their bad outcome).
And indeed, Our Word has already been decreed for Our bondsmen who were sent (i.e. the Prophets).
That undoubtedly, only they will be helped.
And indeed, only Our army will become dominant.
Therefore, turn away from them for some time.
And keep watching them; they will soon see (their bad outcome).
So, are they in haste for Our punishment?
Then when it will descend in their courtyards, so what an evil morning it will be for those who were warned.
And turn away from them for some time.
And wait; they will soon see (their bad outcome).
Purity is to your Lord, the Lord of Honour, from all what they falsely attribute (unto Him).
And peace be upon the Messengers.
And all praise is due to Allah Who is the Lord of all the worlds.
